notes.title: Home Run Derby VR celebrates All-Star Week 2024!
notes.notes:
Home Run Derby VR knocks it out of the park with exciting new updates to celebrate MLB All-Star Week 2024! 

Swing for the fences with motion-based controls that make you feel every epic home run, tag multipliers and aim to achieve victory over your rivals to become the ultimate Home Run Derby champion! Experience the majesty of all 30 MLB Ballparks in an immersive 3D environment, including Globe Life Field, host of the 2024 MLB Home Run Derby and home of the Texas Rangers!
Home Run Derby VR is available for download on Quest, Rift and Steam VR!  Get your copy today! #HRDVR

[u][b]ASG decor in Globe Life Field
[/b][/u]Globe Life Field has been decorated for the 2024 All-Star Game!

[u][b]Welcome Adnan Virk to Home Run Derby VR!
[/b][/u]Completely revamped Home Run Derby VR announcer, now starring Adnan Virk of MLB Network.

[u][b]Daily Ballpark Bonuses
[/b][/u]Time-limited events that change every day and reward players for performing in different ballparks throughout the league.

[u][b]Auto-join public clubhouse
[/b][/u]Players can now optionally elect to automatically join a public clubhouse with other players, where they can start a tournament, compare stats, watch highlights and more.

[u][b]3D Bat preview in equipment locker
[/b][/u]Players can now fully examine batskins in the clubhouse before equipping them.

[u][b]New Batskins
[/b][/u]24 new batskins for players to unlock

notes.title: MLB HOME RUN DERBY VR OPENING DAY 2024 UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Step up to the plate and GO BIG with Home Run Derby VR, presented by Major League Baseball!

GO BIG!
Step into the batter's box and get ready for an action-packed Home Run Derby showdown! Our advanced motion controls will make you feel every swing as you experience the grandeur of all 30 MLB ballparks in an immersive 3D environment, including host of the 2024 MLB Home Run Derby and home of the Texas Rangers, Globe Life Field!

YOUR TICKET TO THE BIG LEAGUES!
Embark on a thrilling journey from Single-A ball to the grand stage of the Major Leagues in the brand-new Progression system! Earn XP to advance through 100 levels, refining your abilities as you work your way through the competition.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR CLUBHOUSE!
Personalize your Clubhouse and flaunt your favorite team’s colors, show off your accolades, and more! Invite friends for some head-to-head competition, play some catch, or kick back and relish in some epic MLB highlights.

EARN BRAGGING RIGHTS!
Tournaments allow up to 8 friends to compete in a nail-biting elimination-style showdown. Strategize, tag multipliers, and swing for the fences to claim victory over your rivals and earn the right to be called Home Run Derby Champion.

INCENTIVES, UNLOCKABLES & CUSTOMIZATIONS!
Player incentives allow you to unlock XP by completing special tasks, such as hitting a homer in every ballpark or launching a 500ft bomb. Accumulate coins to unlock a variety of cosmetic upgrades for your Clubhouse and avatar, such as bat skins, batting gloves, ball trails and more!

notes.title: HRDVR Update 2.0
notes.notes:
Update 2.0 Notes
- Added Dodger Stadium, host of the 2020 All Star Game as a playable ballpark!
- Updated Progressive Field for 2019 with All Star Game artwork, twilight sky.
- Updated Marlins Park for 2019 with new team branding, ballpark renovation.
- Updated Nationals Park for 2019. 
- Improved overall ballpark visuals and performance.  
- Added a “gold ball’ bonus pitch as the last pitch of a round. 
- Added a post-game spray chart that displays the ball trails for all hits in that round.
- New and improved announcer audio!
- Updated menu interface to support high scores, spray charts and other features.
- Added ViveProEye support to menu interface.
- Added Achievement for hitting 25 home runs in Dodger Stadium.
- Optimizations and bug fixes.

notes.title: HRDVR Update 1.02
notes.notes:
Tonight's update addresses the following issues: 

- Ballpark collision fixes. 
- Ballpark texture fixes and improvements.
- Shadow fixes and improvements. 
- Tracking improvements for fast swings which will reduce a batter's tendency to pull the ball and make hitting to the opposite field easier.
- Updated controls on post-game screen. 
- Reduced wait window to play again/return to menu on post-game screen. 
- Leaderboard loading and player display fixes. 
- 50k and 500k achievements are working properly.

notes.title: Oculus Rift Support
notes.notes: We are happy to announce that Home Run Derby VR now officially supports Oculus Rift!  Use the right Touch controller to navigate menus and control the bat.  Welcome to the Derby Rift enthusiasts!

notes.title: SWING FOR THE FENCES!
notes.notes: Home Run Derby VR is officially ready to play!   Major League Baseball is proud to present our home grown, Home Run Derby experience.  Have you ever wondered what it’s like to step up to the plate in an official MLB Ballpark?  Home Run Derby puts you center stage with a crowd of screaming fans, and a bat in your hands.  Check out the most detailed MLB ballparks to come to Virtual Reality today – welcome to the Derby!
